The '''Mirkanite Mining Facility''' was built on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] the substance known as [[Mirkanite/Legends|mirkanite]]. The Empire planned to use this material to construct the [[Concave Dish Composite Beam Superlaser|superlaser]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] mercenary [[Rianna Saren]] [[Mission to Mustafar (Rianna Saren)|destroyed]] the facility, by sabotaging the drill shaft, during her mission for the Alliance to gather intelligence on the Death Star.<ref name="LA" />
